name: minimod3_strong_untuned
description: MiniMod (GiOMP port): 3-D acoustic wave propagation, 350^3 grid split over the ranks in z, 2000 steps (strong scaling: a small slice per GPU, so the halo is about 60% of the time). Each step computes the slice in one fused kernel and then puts the two z faces to the neighbours (GICC_HALO_OVERLAP=2); the compiler can move those puts into the kernel. One GH200 per rank, 3 nodes (the middle rank has two cross-node neighbours). Time is the modeling loop; comm is the halo wait. Starting point: an untuned build, every put left to the host after its kernel (no site pipelined) and every kernel at clang's own distribute chunk.

OMP_NUM_TEAMS.note: teams per kernel for every launch; 0 lets the runtime pick

OMP_TEAMS_THREAD_LIMIT.note: threads per team, at least a warp; unset lets the runtime pick

OMPX_PIPE_COUNT_MIN_LOG2.note: puts smaller than 2^n bytes to a cross-node peer wait for the next quiet instead of being sent by the kernel
